intro: Seventeen Kaspersky-tagged articles published between 16 April and 16 September 2026 cover a period in which CrystalX, GoSerpent, and HelloNet were the most frequently reported threat actors. Coverage centres on two vulnerabilities, CVE-2019-0708 and CVE-2020-0688, alongside activity affecting finance, government, technology, education, and energy. The reporting spans Global, Russia, Southeast asia, Africa, and APAC. Fourteen articles carry a high severity rating and one is rated critical.
